Evaluating strategies for improving ovarian response of the poor responder undergoing assisted reproductive techniques. OBJECTIVE To assess the efficacy of various controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH) regimens in the prior poor-responder patient preparing for assisted reproductive techniques. DESIGN English-language literature review. PATIENT(S) Candidates for assisted reproductive techniques who had been defined as having a prior suboptimal response to standard COH regimens.
